This profile is used for Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) based on claims submitted by providers of oral services including Dental, Denture and Hygiene. The ADA Dental Claim Form provides a common format for reporting dental services to a patient's dental benefit plan.
The profile has requirements for financial data.

http://hl7.org/fhir/us/carin-bb/Structur.description:
This profile is used for Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) based on claims submitted by retail pharmacies.
The claims data is based on submission standards adopted by the Department of Health and Human Services defined by NCPDP (National Council for Prescription Drug Program)
The profile has requirements for financial data.
